The '''Triad of Judgement''' was a tribunal consisting of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Duron Veertag]], and [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]. They oversaw the court-martial of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
